text: Qui no arrisca, no pisca.
author: Valencian proverb
translation: He who doesn't risk, doesn't catch anything.

text: A poc a poc, es fa el got.
author: Valencian proverb
translation: Little by little, the jug is filled.

text: Qui sembra vents, recull tempestats.
author: Valencian proverb
translation: He who sows winds, reaps storms.

text: El sol ix per a tots.
author: Valencian proverb
translation: The sun rises for everyone.

text: De ponent, ni vent ni parent.
author: Valencian proverb
translation: From the west, neither wind nor relative.

text: Qui té un bon veí, té un bon matí.
author: Valencian proverb
translation: He who has a good neighbour, has a good morning.

text: No deixes per a demà el que pugues fer hui.
author: Valencian proverb
translation: Don't leave for tomorrow what you can do today.

text: La paraula d'or, costa poc i val molt.
author: Valencian proverb
translation: A good word costs little and is worth much.

text: Qui no plora, no mama.
author: Valencian proverb
translation: He who doesn't cry, doesn't suckle (He who doesn't ask, doesn't get).

text: Més val sol que mal acompanyat.
author: Valencian proverb
translation: Better alone than in bad company.

text: Qui va a la mar, perd la por.
author: Valencian proverb
translation: He who goes to the sea, loses fear.

text: L'aigua tot ho renta, menys la mala fama.
author: Valencian proverb
translation: Water washes everything, except a bad reputation.

text: Qui té temps, no té pressa.
author: Valencian proverb
translation: He who has time, has no rush.

text: Amb paciència s'arriba a la ciència.
author: Valencian proverb
translation: With patience, one reaches science (knowledge).

text: L'home proposa i Déu disposa.
author: Valencian proverb
translation: Man proposes and God disposes.

text: No hi ha mal que cent anys dure.
author: Valencian proverb
translation: There is no evil that lasts a hundred years.

text: A la taula i al llit, el primer crit.
author: Valencian proverb
translation: At the table and in bed, the first shout (first come, first served).

text: Qui res no té, res no val.
author: Valencian proverb
translation: He who has nothing, is worth nothing.

text: El peix gran es menja el xicotet.
author: Valencian proverb
translation: The big fish eats the small one.

text: De mica en mica, s'ompli la pica.
author: Valencian proverb
translation: Little by little, the basin fills up.

text: Pels sants de la pedra, a l'octubre, cull la figa i la magrana.
author: Valencian proverb
translation: By the stone saints (late October), harvest the fig and the pomegranate.

text: Qui va a València, aprén a ser pacient.
author: Valencian proverb
translation: He who goes to Valencia, learns to be patient.

text: Sol de ponent, aigua al darrere.
author: Valencian proverb
translation: Sun in the west, water behind.

text: No digues 'd'aquesta aigua no beuré'.
author: Valencian proverb
translation: Don't say 'I will not drink from this water' (Never say never).

text: Qui molt abraça, poc estreny.
author: Valencian proverb
translation: He who embraces much, squeezes little.

text: A cavall regalat, no li mires el dentat.
author: Valencian proverb
translation: Don't look a gift horse in the mouth.

text: Qui calla, atorga.
author: Valencian proverb
translation: He who is silent, grants (Silence gives consent).

text: Déu tanca una porta i obri una finestra.
author: Valencian proverb
translation: God closes a door and opens a window.

text: Per Sant Joan, el dia és llarg.
author: Valencian proverb
translation: For Saint John (late June), the day is long.

text: Qui no vulga pols, que no vaja a l'era.
author: Valencian proverb
translation: He who doesn't want dust, shouldn't go to the threshing floor.

text: De boda i de mort, tots en volen la part.
author: Valencian proverb
translation: From a wedding and a death, everyone wants their share.

text: L'ocasió fa el lladre.
author: Valencian proverb
translation: Opportunity makes the thief.

text: Tal com raja.
author: Valencian proverb
translation: As it flows (Just let it be / Go with the flow).

text: A poc a poc i bona lletra.
author: Valencian proverb
translation: Slowly but surely (Little by little, and good handwriting).

text: Qui no és bo per a si, no és bo per a ningú.
author: Valencian proverb
translation: He who is not good for himself, is not good for anyone.

text: El temps ho cura tot.
author: Valencian proverb
translation: Time heals everything.

text: Qui va de pressa, no arriba lluny.
author: Valencian proverb
translation: He who rushes, doesn't go far.

text: Els diners no fan la felicitat.
author: Valencian proverb
translation: Money doesn't buy happiness.

text: Qui té un amic, té un tresor.
author: Valencian proverb
translation: He who has a friend, has a treasure.

text: Més val tard que mai.
author: Valencian proverb
translation: Better late than never.
